## Professional summary

Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10+ years building scalable, secure platforms across payments, SaaS, real-time messaging, e-commerce and public-sector systems. I have delivered solutions supporting **15,000+ concurrent users** and backend messaging flows reaching **hundreds of millions of interactions**, and led payment systems processing **R$1.8B+ in transactions**. My core stack is Node.js (TypeScript), NestJS and Express on the backend, Angular / React / Next.js on the frontend, with MongoDB, PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server, Docker, CI/CD and AWS & Azure. I work daily with microservices, REST and Graph APIs, event-driven architecture, webhooks and WebSockets. I also build AI integrations (GPT API, agents, automation) and use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Lovable for coding, refactoring, testing and rapid prototyping.

## Core skills

- **Backend**: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express, Microservices, REST APIs, Graph APIs, Webhooks, WebSockets, Event-driven, SOAP
- **Frontend**: Angular, React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
- **Data**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, REDIS, SQL Optimization
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub
- **AI & Automation**: GPT API, AI Agents, Automation, Claude Code, Lovable, AI-Assisted Dev
- **Security**: Secure by design, LGPD / GDPR, Data protection, Access control
